name: Subset Sum / Partition Equal Subset
description: Determine if a subset of the given array sums to a target value. Uses 2D DP table where dp[i][j] = can we achieve sum j using first i elements.
aim: Check if any subset of the array sums to target using dp[i][j]: true if we can make sum j using elements up to index i.
howItWorks: For each element arr[i] and sum j:
dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j] (skip element) OR dp[i-1][j-arr[i]] (include element)

complexity.spaceDescription: 2D boolean table; optimizable to O(target) with 1D array

realWorld: Partition array into two equal sum halves
whenToUse: Check if target sum reachable from subset
alternatives: Meet in middle — O(2^(n/2)) for larger target
Greedy — only if all elements positive and target is sum/2
